about: Planted type errors for scripts/typecheck-selftest.mjs. Cases: single-site mutations of client/src at the recorded commit (applied to that commit's client/ tree, extracted with git archive, so they never go stale), each with every diagnostic TypeScript 6.0.3 reported (file, line, code; a line can carry the same one twice); alsoAccept lists the codes tsc-rs (like TypeScript 7) reports instead at the same place by design. Fixtures: one file per tsconfig strictness option under tests/typecheck/fixtures, with the diagnostics TypeScript 6.0.3 reported (an empty list means none). Recorded once, 2026-11-11, from TypeScript 6.0.3 and checked against tsc-rs 0.8.0.
